title: Horseshoe Predictive Inference
summary: Predictive inference in the sparse Gaussian sequence model has received considerably less attention than its non-sparse, finite-sample counterpart. Existing work has largely been confined to discrete mixture priors. In this paper, we study predictive inference under a widely used continuous mixture prior, the Horseshoe. We provide new theoretical results establishing exact asymptotic minimax optimality of the predictive Bayes estimator when the sparsity level is known.
